page_title: Leading Platform for Agentic Automation & AI Agents | Beam AI

summary.name: Beam AI
summary.one_liner: Beam AI is an enterprise platform for building, deploying and running AI agents that automate business processes, with human approval for high-stakes decisions.
use_cases: Ranking departmental processes by volume and cost to pick first automation
Turning standard operating procedures into AI agents without code
Automating routine cases while routing exceptions to staff
Running auditable AI decisions for compliance-sensitive work
Deploying agents in EU, US, GCC or on-premise environments
summary.what_it_does: Beam maps the processes in a department and ranks them by volume and cost to suggest which work to automate first. Users can upload an existing rulebook or SOP document, which the platform says it converts into a working agent without code. Routine cases run automatically, while decisions above set thresholds are sent to a person, and every step is logged for audit. The page says agents learn from team feedback and apply those lessons to later runs. It also states SOC 2 Type II certification, GDPR compliance, deployment options in the EU, US, GCC or on the customer's own infrastructure, and a policy of not training on customer data.
notable: Turns SOP documents (up to 200 pages cited) into agents without code
Human approval thresholds with full audit logging
SOC 2 Type II certified and GDPR compliant; deployable on own infrastructure
Agents learn from team corrections and feedback over time
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Performance claims (98% accuracy, 10M+ tasks, four-week deployment) are vendor-reported marketing figures and the case studies are not summarized here
